name: gramo
description: Gramo — headless WordPress + Gatsby build (gramo-core plugin, admin-shell block theme, Gatsby frontend). Root workspace: tooling, local dev, and asset builds.
author: Gramo — Agency Build

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=wp-content/themes/gramo && npm run build:blocks
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.env:install-content: wp-env run cli wp gramo install
scripts.postinstall: node -e "console.log('\n[gramo] Node deps installed. Next: composer install (PHP tooling), then npm run env:start to boot the local WordPress, then npm run build to compile future SCSS/JS entries. See docs/setup.md.')"
